title: Eval cases for one book skill
description: Minimum viable eval suite auto-generated with each skill. Counts are enforced by the validator (5/5/5/3).

id.description: Stable id, e.g. trigger-001, anti-001, application-001, edge-001.

expected.description: Observable behaviors the skill-enabled agent should exhibit.

must_avoid.description: Behaviors that would mean the skill is misfiring (required for negative_trigger, optional otherwise).
